decisions.evidence: Putting the six neighbors together, the three positive neighbors consistently match the query’s 2H-chromen-2-one motif and its more favorable charge/lipophilicity profile, while the three negative neighbors still show the query as more skin-accessible and electronically more compatible with a reactive outcome than the non-reactive references. The repeated presence of 2H-chromen-2-one in the query, along with the higher logD/logP and the charge-pattern differences, makes the overall local analog evidence support option (B): causes a skin reaction.
